disposition_semantics.BLOCK_SNAPSHOT: Reject active publication for this candidate; previous accepted head/read model unchanged. Retain candidate evidence/error.
disposition_semantics.WITHHOLD_FIELD: Keep resolved row, retain original value privately, withhold affected normalized/exposure field and dependent constraint verdict. No positive claim for unknown facts.
disposition_semantics.WITHHOLD_ROW: Accept structurally complete snapshot when otherwise valid; retain row and reason privately, omit from current_sch, publish independently verified rows. Never mark omitted row current/eligible.
disposition_semantics.aggregate_reporting: PUBLISHED_WITH_LIMITATIONS when any row/field withheld; report source_rows, exposed_rows, withheld_rows, withheld_fields and per-reason counts. Schema/data completeness is distinct from complete consumer rule coverage.
disposition_semantics.canonical_preservation: Withholding does not mutate or delete canonical funds, AMC data or immutable previous snapshots.
